name: Cyberacer v0.0.1
author: yangshiyuan1
description:
Dear Mentors & Orbiters,

1       Welcome to Cyberace v0.0.1 — Milestone I Submission Built!

2       This is a built dedicated to your evaluation of Milestone I.

3       Current Built consists of:

          -      Basic Player Car Acceleration
          -      Basic Player Car Steering
          -      Basic Player Car Terrain Reaction
          -      Basic Player Car Drifting
          -      Basic Player Car Reaction with Environmental GameObjects
          -      Basic Player Car Sound Effect - Engine, Drifting, Collision
          -      Test Circuit for Milestone I Evaluation
          (Current Built runs only in WebGL Project)

4     Keyboard Control:

          -      Key W:  Forward Acceleration
          -      Key S: Reverse Acceleration
          -      Key A: Left Turn
          -      Key D: Right Turn
          -      Key C: Change Camera View

5     Your feedback and suggestions are the uttermost helpful guide we can have in the development process. Feel free to leave a comment!

6     Thank you very much!


Best Regards,
Team Aston Martin Henz.
